scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:engine && bun run typecheck:bench && bun run typecheck:kblue
scripts.typecheck:engine: bun run --cwd packages/kierston-records typecheck && bun run --cwd kierston/sim typecheck && bun run --cwd kierston/pathfinder typecheck && bun run --cwd tools/iceberg typecheck
scripts.typecheck:bench: bun run --cwd packages/provider-rows typecheck && bun run --cwd kierston_scenarios typecheck && bun run --cwd fastgate typecheck && bun run --cwd kierston_bench/kdi typecheck && bun run --cwd kierston_bench/task_generators typecheck && bun run --cwd kierston_bench/run_series_prep typecheck && bun run --cwd kierston_bench/eval_runner typecheck && bun run --cwd kierston_bench/scoring typecheck && bun run --cwd kierston_bench/bench_cli typecheck
scripts.test: bun test --timeout 180000 packages/kierston-records kierston/sim kierston/pathfinder kierston_scenarios fastgate kierston_bench tools/iceberg tools/run-browser
scripts.check-boundaries: bun run kierston/sim/scripts/check-boundaries.ts && bun run kierston/sim/scripts/check-locale.ts
